improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon, the Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-gideon-preview.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating the product, its AI foundation, and the free-trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price anchor (US$2/day) sets expectations and qualifies traffic before the click.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business decisions. Try three searches free, no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline clearly positions Gideon's core function while the subheading delivers three key conversion elements: specific features (instant answers, voice chat, professional support), a concrete free trial offer (three searches), and friction reduction (no credit card). The copy is direct and benefit-focused without making unsubstantiated claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace built for serious business and trade professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most critical friction point in the conversion funnel—the transition from free trial to paid membership. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and value proposition, it reduces uncertainty and positions the paywall as a natural next step rather than a barrier.
